changelog:
⚠️ FINAL UPDATE — v4.0.0 marks the end of nc-taxijob development. Thank you for using the resource!

An open-source version is in preparation and will be announced separately.

—

Dispatch panel (/taxidispatch or F7, both customizable via Config.Commands.Dispatch/DispatchKey): full-screen map + call board showing NPC calls and phone requests together — a fallback for servers without a supported phone. Cards show pickup, destination, estimated fare, distance and passenger count, with a road-route preview (player to pickup dashed, pickup to destination solid) powered by nc-minimap. The panel is silent for non-eligible players: JobRequired=true needs clock-in, JobRequired=false needs a taxi or meter-installed vehicle. Multi-passenger parties via Config.NpcMission.Dispatch.Group (Enabled, Chance, MaxSize, FareBonusPerPassenger): NPC calls now roll 2-3 passenger groups that board together, share one destination, sit rear-first (front seat only for parties of 3+), wave while waiting, flee as a group, and pay a per-passenger fare bonus. Accepting a call now validates free seats and requires being in a vehicle. Desk and garage NPCs now survive late logins and restreams (30s model timeout, respawn watcher, visibility follows job changes). The meter's side panel shows the zone addon info, or the current street and area when the addon is not installed.
